baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 ءَالَاءِ, word 3 رَبِّ, and word 4 تُكَذِّبَانِ form a dual-addressed interrogative.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal is placed under active lordship, then the two addressees are asked which concrete bestowals they jointly declare false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the interrogated objects and keep the question tied to experienced gifts.
Lordship, ownership, and authority make the gifts accountable to their sovereign source.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false makes the dual verb an active verdict, not passive ignorance.

changed_reading.before: A generic repeated question about blessings.
changed_reading.after: A direct cross-examination of two addressees: which experienced acts of their sovereign Lord will they jointly pronounce unreal or false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct رَبِّكُمَا binds the favors to the one repairing and forming both addressees, while تُكَذِّبَانِ can fail a charge in action.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor is not only a possessed item but an unfinished act of nurture; its truth becomes visible when the recipients carry its formative charge through rather than aborting it.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal provides the received good whose purpose remains at issue.
Repair, nurture, and completion turn lordship into an ongoing formative process.
A charge proves true by being carried through and false by failing, making denial behavioral.

changed_reading.before: Favors are finished possessions that call for verbal acknowledgment.
changed_reading.after: Favors are acts of formation still seeking completion in the recipients; denial includes making that entrusted formation fail in practice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory of ءَالَاءِ at word 2 includes capacity, while the dual imperfect تُكَذِّبَانِ at word 4 can image a charge that either holds or fails.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is bestowed may be enabling power rather than an object; capacity is verified by faithful exercise and is made to look false when its holders refuse or fail to carry it through.

activation_trace.role: Ability or attained capacity recasts the questioned favors as powers entrusted to the pair.
Sovereign ownership makes those capacities granted rather than autonomous.
The image of a charge fulfilled or failed supplies the test by which capacity proves itself.

changed_reading.after: The question also probes entrusted powers: which Lord-given capacities will the pair make false by failing their charge?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: At word 2 the ء ل و inventory includes oath, and at word 3 the ر ب ب inventory includes a binding pact.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gift-question can carry a covenantal underside: bestowal binds giver and recipients, and denial contests not only facts but the claim that now follows from them.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making opens a pledged dimension within the same focus root.
A covenant gathered into a binding bundle makes lordship relationally obligating.
Attribution of falsehood supplies the act by which the binding claim is disputed.

changed_reading.before: The refrain asks for recognition of generosity.
changed_reading.after: The refrain also sounds like a covenantal claim: which gift-bound obligations of your Lord will you treat as having no truth?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant split mapping of ءَالَاءِ at word 2 supplies a voice following a voice, while the verb addresses two respondents together.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can function as a call that creates an answer-slot: one voice issues the question and the paired addressees are pressed to supply the following voice rather than remain silent.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies an antiphonal mechanism for the dual-addressed question.
The act of declaring false specifies the answer the question challenges the pair to utter or withhold.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained rhetorical question needing no response.
changed_reading.after: A call that opens a dangerous response-slot for two voices: what verdict will follow the Lord's question?

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier just scale and the immediate deliberate turn toward the 'two weighty ones' convert the refrain into an accounting checkpoint: gifts and entrusted charges are now weighed for whether they were carried through.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true or false by performance anchors the focus question in accountable action.
The scale of justice supplies the evaluative apparatus later brought to the focus refrain.
Justice and equity specify the norm by which the pair's performance is assessed.
Deliberately turning to a matter makes the coming address a purposeful reckoning rather than idle repetition.
Measured weight lets the dual audience's title reactivate the surah's scale as an accounting image.

structural_cues: The scale commands at 55:7-9 precede 55:31's naming of the dual audience as the two weighty ones, and 55:32 immediately questions that pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies justice, scale, deliberate attention, and measured weight. I infer an accounting arrow from those elements into the refrain. A live alternative is moral gravity without a tribunal-like weighing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A gratitude refrain inserted after a warning.
changed_reading.after: A docket question to the two weight-bearing parties: which endowments and charges will fail when their response is put on the just scale?

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats capacity and passage across bounded sides, then conditions passage on compelling proof and authority; this sharply activates the focus root's capacity branch while subordinating every power to lordly warrant.

activation_trace.role: Capacity within the questioned focus root becomes the latent object tested by the escape challenge.
Sovereign lordship establishes whose bounds and permissions govern the capacity.
Ability and power state the proposed condition for escape in the same capacity register.
Clean passage to the other side gives capacity a concrete boundary-crossing test.
Sides and outer regions supply the bounded domain that attempted passage must traverse.
Compelling proof makes the exception evidentiary rather than a boast of raw force.
Power and jurisdiction make successful passage dependent on authorized dominion.

structural_cues: 55:32 sits between the announced turn toward the pair in 55:31 and the repeated pass-if-you-can challenge of 55:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacity, cross-boundary passage, sides, proof, and authority. I infer that a capacity proves genuine only under valid warrant from the Lord. A live alternative is that سلطان denotes sufficient force alone rather than authorization or proof.

changed_reading.before: Which external favors do you deny?
changed_reading.after: Which Lord-given powers and warrants do you deny while testing whether any capacity can cross his jurisdictional bounds without his proof or authority?

context_deltas.mechanism: An emptying or pouring branch in the announcement before the focus, followed by a molten-copper branch under the boundary word and actual copper after it, produces a material cascade: directed attention can be imagined as a poured intervention, severe yet still counted among lordly acts.

activation_trace.role: The favor branch creates the paradox that even a severe divine intervention is placed inside the questioned bestowals.
Sovereign lordship supplies the agent directing the intervention toward the pair.
Pouring while emptying a vessel gives the announced turn a material discharge image.
Molten copper hidden in the boundary root carries the pouring image across the focus question.
Red metallic copper downstream gives the otherwise distant molten-metal activation a visible material endpoint.

structural_cues: The focus refrain is the hinge between the announcement in 55:31 and the boundary challenge and fiery consequence in 55:33-35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel-emptying, molten copper, and metallic copper. I supply the arrow that treats them as one directed pouring sequence through 55:32. The materially live alternative is the ordinary sense of turning deliberately to a task, with the copper images unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The warning interrupts an otherwise beneficent refrain.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether the pair will deny even the severe, poured interventions by which sovereign attention makes hidden limits real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same question immediately before and after 55:32, joined to branches of following voice and ordered succession, changes repetition into turn-taking: each event is followed by a vocal checkpoint that solicits the pair's verdict.

activation_trace.role: A voice following a voice anchors an antiphonal possibility directly in the focus root's split inventory.
The preceding occurrence supplies the first answering-voice station in the local cadence.
The following occurrence supplies the next station and makes 55:32 one turn in a continuing exchange.
Ordered succession under the intervening boundary word reinforces a sequence of event then response.

structural_cues: The identical refrain at 55:30, 55:32, and 55:34 alternates with a new divine act or challenge rather than forming an undifferentiated block.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated identical lines, a following-voice branch, and succession. I infer a call-and-response arrow in which silence itself becomes an answer. A live alternative is emphatic rhetorical repetition without any enacted respondent voice.

changed_reading.before: A repeated formula that closes the preceding unit.
changed_reading.after: An antiphonal checkpoint after each disclosure, opening a response turn in which the two addressees must voice or embody their verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal inclusion followed by cessation, one enduring face, and continuing affairs activates the focus denial-root's image of expected supply failing to last; denial becomes a temporal misjudgment about what is durable and what disappears.

activation_trace.role: A supply that vanishes instead of lasting supplies the focus anchor for disappointed expectations of continuity.
Staying and lasting place endurance inside the Lord-root as the counterpole to failed persistence.
Complete enclosure makes the announced perishing comprehensive rather than exceptional.
Cessation and departure after prior persistence establish the transient side of the contrast.
Continuance and remaining establish the enduring side immediately after universal cessation.
The face standing for the very self makes the enduring pole personal lordship rather than an abstract residue.
Each affair or condition supplies ongoing activity within the endurance contrast.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 moves from all passing, to the Lord's face remaining, to recurrent affairs, before 55:31-32 turns toward the two addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive cessation, remaining selfhood, and continuing affairs. I infer that denial includes betting one's life on the wrong persistence. A live alternative is that the passage contrasts ontological states without changing the practical force of تكذبان.

changed_reading.before: Denial is chiefly a false verbal judgment about favors.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a false durability forecast: treating transient supports as reliable and the abiding Lord's active claim as though it will fail to persist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks for a verdict, but the later sequence removes interrogation, identifies agents by visible marks, and seizes them for fault; the answer to 55:32 is therefore legible in embodied condition and conduct before it is spoken.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action allows the focus denial to become conduct readable without testimony.
Questioning and requesting supply the act explicitly suspended at the later judgment scene.
Recognition by an effect or sign replaces verbal examination with evidentiary discernment.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known turns prior denial into an exposed condition.
Being taken to account for fault converts recognition into executed consequence.

structural_cues: The explicit question at 55:32 is later answered by the sequence 'not asked' at 55:39 and 'recognized by marks' at 55:41.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suspended questioning, recognition by signs, visible marking, and taking for fault. I infer that 55:32 seeks disclosure rather than information and that the pair's lives answer it. A live alternative is that the later marks merely identify criminals without retroactively changing the refrain's speech act.

changed_reading.before: The question waits for a spoken admission or denial.
changed_reading.after: The question stages a verdict already becoming visible: denial is an embodied mark and enacted falsehood that needs no later testimony to expose it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal recompense, good action, and fixed growing good make acknowledgment insufficient: bestowed nurture creates a claim for a corresponding enacted answer, so the refrain tests reciprocity as well as belief.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors provide the initiating side of the reciprocal relation.
Nurture and completion define the good action received from the Lord.
A charge fulfilled or failed makes the recipients' corresponding action the test of truth.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit reciprocal mechanism.
Doing a good act gives reciprocity an enacted rather than merely verbal form.
Fixed, growing good shows blessing as productive continuity rather than a closed transfer.

structural_cues: The branchless ج ل ل occurrences at 55:27 and 55:78 bracket enduring lordship and the closing blessed name; they are used here only as a structural cue, with no branch identity assigned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal recompense, enacted good, and growing blessing. I infer that received nurture calls forth a matching response from the recipients. A live alternative is that 55:60 describes divine reward only and does not make the refrain itself reciprocal.

changed_reading.before: Acknowledging favors is mainly a matter of assenting that they exist.
changed_reading.after: The pair must answer bestowed good with enacted good; a gift is denied when its reciprocal claim is allowed to fail.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a dyed-cloth branch under ك ذ ب rather than the ordinary denial sense. It remains anchored in focus word 4 and gains material support when the sky becomes a red flower-like, oil-coated surface. Render it only as an exploratory analogy about deceptive appearance, never as a replacement translation of تكذبان.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 تُكَذِّبَانِ carries a branch in which a variegated textile deceives by its state.

activation_trace.role: A deceptively variegated dyed cloth turns denial into susceptibility to a surface that misstates its condition.
Flower and red-infused color supply the transformed sky's variegated visual field.
Oil or coating gives that colored field a mutable material surface rather than stable appearance.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a proposition spoken against truth.
changed_reading.after: Denial may also be captivity to a persuasive surface, mistaking the world's current appearance for its stable truth even as the sky's fabric changes state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the wild-animal motion branch of ك ذ ب, far from the focus verb's ordinary causative semantics. It remains anchored at focus word 4 and is activated by the immediate challenge to pass beyond outer sides. Render it as a contained kinetic analogy for failed escape, not as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 تُكَذِّبَانِ has an inventory branch of an animal running a stage, stopping, and looking back.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping supplies a bodily image of an attempted course proving unable to continue.
Passage all the way through gives the attempted flight its success criterion.
Sides and extremities provide the limit at which the attempted course stalls.

changed_reading.before: The pair deny by making a verbal claim.
changed_reading.after: The pair can enact denial as flight: they run as though the Lord's bounds were false, only for the course itself to stop and expose the premise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the plant-name branch of ء ل و, whose shrub is beautiful in appearance but bitter in taste. The exact focus root anchors it, and the surah's tree and desirable-fruit register gives the sensory contrast somewhere to operate. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy showing that a favor need not feel pleasant, not as the noun's denotation in 55:32.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 ءَالَاءِ has a branch naming a good-looking, bitter-tasting shrub.

activation_trace.role: The beautiful but bitter shrub introduces a mismatch between visible attractiveness and tasted value within the focus root.
The stemmed tree establishes a literal arboreal register in the surrounding surah.
Desirable fruit supplies the expected pleasant taste against which the bitter branch becomes diagnostic.

changed_reading.before: A favor is self-evidently pleasant and therefore easy to recognize.
changed_reading.after: Some lordly acts may be beautiful yet bitter, so the question tests whether value is denied merely because experience does not taste like reward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant ت ل و mapping of the focus root and treats a gift as carrying a claim that follows its holder. It remains anchored in focus word 2, reinforced by the Lord-root's pact branch and later debt-settlement imagery. Render it as a legal-relational activation alongside, not instead of, bestowed favors.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 ءَالَاءِ maps secondarily to a branch of liability or a right that follows its holder.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability following its holder makes each received gift trail an unresolved claim.
A binding covenant under the Lord-root turns the trailing claim into a relational obligation.
A charge fulfilled or failed provides the eventual disposition of that obligation.
Debt collection and full settlement give the gift's following claim a downstream settlement image.

changed_reading.before: Favors are unencumbered assets possessed by the recipients.
changed_reading.after: Every favor also follows its holders as a claim awaiting reciprocal settlement; denial is an attempt to sever gift from obligation.

strongest_changes: The immediate capacity-passage-authority sequence turns ءَالَاءِ from gifts alone into entrusted powers whose truth depends on warrant.
The scale and 'two weighty ones' sequence turns the refrain into an accounting checkpoint for performed charges.
The later removal of questioning and recognition by visible marks makes denial an embodied verdict rather than only spoken disbelief.
The passing-versus-abiding sequence makes denial a false forecast about what will endure.
Reciprocal recompense preserves favors as gifts while adding an enacted obligation to answer good with good.
summary.what_was_special: The split ء ل و inventory kept favors, capacity, oath, following voice, and trailing liability alive together. Immediate boundary language and later material, temporal, legal, and reciprocal sequences changed the same refrain into several coexisting mechanisms rather than forcing one final sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ت ل و activations are packet-authorized but form-distant, so antiphonal and liability readings should remain explicitly exploratory.
The pouring-to-molten-copper sequence may be a productive material bridge or an overextension across adjacent roots.
The later recognition-by-marks sequence may change the force of 55:32 itself, or may only disclose the consequence of an otherwise ordinary rhetorical question.
The bitter-shrub and variegated-cloth images are useful sensory models but should not displace the dominant favors and declaring-false branches.
